description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for inventory operations such as retrieving inventory, selling items, and withdrawing items for authenticated users.

methods.name: router.get '/'
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch current user's inventory.

methods.name: router.post '/:inventoryId/sell'
methods.description: Handles POST requests to sell an inventory item.

methods.name: router.post '/:inventoryId/withdraw'
methods.description: Handles POST requests to withdraw an inventory item.
